scientific_contract.unit_of_analysis: A named field experiment or process, not whole-site resemblance.
scientific_contract.classification: Rule-based qualitative transferability classes authored in science/build_transferability.py; not probabilities, not a universal similarity score, not NASA certification.

classes.moderate: A bounded Earth process or field method is useful to rehearse; planetary environmental transfer remains limited.
classes.limited: Only a subset of the method/process transfers, or important site-specific evidence is missing.
classes.high: Reserved for cases with strong direct evidence and independent validation; none is assigned automatically in this release.

global_limitations: Earth cannot reproduce lunar vacuum, reduced gravity or planetary radiation.
Earth cannot reproduce Mars atmospheric pressure/composition or gravity.
A coarse DEM or gridded climate product is not a landing, trafficability, ice-access or resource certification.
Candidate leads require independent ground truth and domain-scientist review.

terrain_mobility.label: Terrain & mobility rehearsal
terrain_mobility.what_transfers: DEM processing, slope/relief interpretation, route-planning workflows and sensor-fusion procedures can be rehearsed on terrestrial terrain.
terrain_mobility.breaks: Earth gravity, atmosphere, soil cohesion, vegetation, hydrology and vehicle dynamics differ; 925 m terrain cells cannot resolve rover-scale hazards.
terrain_mobility.next_measurement: Acquire metre-to-centimetre DEM/LiDAR, grain-size and bearing-strength observations; validate traverses with an instrumented rover.

spectral_ground_truth.label: Orbital-to-ground spectral validation
spectral_ground_truth.what_transfers: Scene selection, atmospheric/cloud screening, spectral-index QA, field spectroscopy and orbital-to-ground provenance workflows.
spectral_ground_truth.breaks: Earth vegetation, water, atmosphere and biological coatings alter spectra; Sentinel-2 bands are not a substitute for lunar/Martian instrument response or mineral identification.
spectral_ground_truth.next_measurement: Collect calibrated field spectra and XRD/XRF/FTIR samples, then compare with the relevant planetary instrument response functions.

evaporite_processes.label: Evaporite / playa process science
evaporite_processes.what_transfers: Basin mapping, sediment facies logging, salt-crust morphology, desiccation structures and repeat-observation methods.
evaporite_processes.breaks: Earth liquid water, rainfall, groundwater, biology and atmospheric pressure create processes absent or different on the Moon and many Martian settings.
evaporite_processes.next_measurement: Map facies and stratigraphy; collect mineralogical samples, electrical conductivity, shallow cores and repeat wet/dry observations.

cryosphere_remote_sensing.label: Ice / cold-region remote sensing
cryosphere_remote_sensing.what_transfers: Debris-versus-ice mapping, thermal/optical sensor calibration, cold equipment trials and field logistics in difficult terrain.
cryosphere_remote_sensing.breaks: Terrestrial glacier ice is not equivalent to lunar permanently shadowed regolith ice; pressure, sublimation, gravity and radiation differ.
cryosphere_remote_sensing.next_measurement: Pair thermal imagery with ground temperature strings, snow/ice pits, dielectric measurements and independently validated ice/debris boundaries.

volcanic_morphology.label: Volcanic / lava morphology
volcanic_morphology.what_transfers: Lava-flow morphology mapping, roughness characterization, tube/cave reconnaissance and orbital-to-ground geologic mapping methods.
volcanic_morphology.breaks: Earth weathering, vegetation, atmosphere, gravity and composition differ; andesite or altered tuff must not be called basaltic equivalence.
volcanic_morphology.next_measurement: Map flow units and clast sizes; obtain petrography, XRF/XRD and high-resolution terrain/cave surveys.

dust_processes.label: Dust / aeolian instrument testing
dust_processes.what_transfers: Wind-sensor deployment, particle collection, surface-change monitoring, dust-camera calibration and threshold-measurement procedures.
dust_processes.breaks: Earth air density, humidity, grain charging, gravity and wind stress differ substantially; 10 m wind speed is not dust flux or saltation threshold.
dust_processes.next_measurement: Measure particle-size distribution, threshold friction velocity, vertical dust flux, humidity and surface crust strength using a calibrated field station.

impact_geology.label: Impact-structure field geology
impact_geology.what_transfers: Crater morphology mapping, ejecta/fault documentation, breccia logging and impact-geology field protocols.
impact_geology.breaks: Terrestrial erosion, water, atmosphere and gravity modify crater preservation; terrestrial target rocks differ from lunar regolith and impact melt.
impact_geology.next_measurement: Map ejecta and structural relations at high resolution; sample impactites and compare petrography/geochemistry.

human_robotic_ops.label: Human / robotic field operations
human_robotic_ops.what_transfers: Remote team coordination, navigation interfaces, sampling workflows, communications procedures, logistics and human-factors evaluation.
human_robotic_ops.breaks: No Earth field site reproduces EVA suits, vacuum, radiation, reduced gravity, lunar dust electrostatics or Mars atmospheric constraints.
human_robotic_ops.next_measurement: Run a controlled mission simulation with timed tasks, comms latency, equipment failure injection and documented operator workload.

tests.analogy_breaks: Earth liquid water, rainfall, groundwater, biology and atmospheric pressure create processes absent or different on the Moon and many Martian settings.
tests.next_measurement: Map facies and stratigraphy; collect mineralogical samples, electrical conductivity, shallow cores and repeat wet/dry observations.
